correccionUsuario: La mayoría de las cubiertas deben desarrollar escenas o interacciones con detalles significativos; evitar iconos aislados demasiado simples.
criterio: Motivos contrastados con los textos alternativos del catálogo y prompts del historial. Variación de motivos, paleta, escala, tipografía, alineación y composición.

seleccion.descripcion: Un barómetro de cristal contiene una tormenta geométrica que se transforma en copos ordenados sobre fondo lila.
seleccion.composicion: NO PEOPLE. A STORM GLASS instrument as an elongated navy-outlined oval on a coral pedestal. Inside its pale mint shape, sharp cobalt crystal clusters swirl at top and settle into orderly angular flakes at bottom, one broad violet curve joins the states. Beside it three short measurement marks, no numbers. Rich LILAC background, mint/navy/coral. Flat conceptual meteorological drawing, absolutely no transparent or realistic glass shading. TITLE «ANSIEDAD» HUGE deepblue heavy compressed capitals spans center-upper area, with instrument offset lower-right. Exact message top-left deepplum heavy rounded serif THREE lines90px. Lowerleft crystal geometry balances picture, no brain, face, clouds or extra objects.

seleccion.motivo: sacacorchos pequeño y corcho gigante / corkscrew
seleccion.descripcion: Un sacacorchos pequeño extrae un corcho enorme de un cuello azul, usando una espiral coral.
seleccion.composicion: NO PEOPLE. Clever scale reversal: a tiny but bold CORAL CORKSCREW with simple T-handle effortlessly lifts a MASSIVE ochre CORK out of an oversized COBALT BOTTLE NECK cropped at bottom. Cork has exactly six flat plum flecks, screw bold coral zigzag spiral. Three cream marks show its upward movement. Vivid ORANGE RED background with cream empty patch behind title. Title upper-left in darkplum bold serif: «David» comparatively small, «y GOLIAT» huge ultra-condensed block lettering occupying middleleft, art rightbottom. Message bottomleft ivory geometric heavy sans FOUR short lines85px. Flat witty poster, no realistic wood or glass, no bottlelabel.

seleccion.motivo: palanca de desvío ferroviario / railway switch
seleccion.descripcion: Una palanca coral dirige dos recorridos ferroviarios azul y verde, vistos como un plano gráfico sobre fondo marfil.
seleccion.composicion: NO PEOPLE OR TRAINS. Elegant top-down graphic RAILWAY SWITCH: two clean pairs of deepblue rails branch diagonally through cover, with 6 broad coral sleepers, a large red switching lever and its round cobalt pivot near lower-right. One rail route mint, one blue, strongly designed rhythmic geometry, no perspective landscape. Warm IVORY backdrop with broad mint top corner, red/navy accents. Title «DECÍDETE» enormous deepblue geometric square sans placed DIAGONALLY across uppermiddle clear ivory space, with acute accent complete. Exact message TOP LEFT darkred bold italic serif FOUR lines90px. Rails below guide eye across bottom, visually complex but very clean flat shapes, no arrows/roadsigns or numbers.

seleccion.descripcion: Una alcachofa verde abre grandes hojas geométricas alrededor de un centro coral, sobre fondo rosa y amarillo.
seleccion.composicion: NO PEOPLE. A spectacular ARTICHOKE opens its thick pointed leaves like a confident burst. Broad outer leaves deepteal and mint, inner leaves cobalt and rich green, exposed center a coral oval with three ivory concentric strokes. Cut stem bends left, two detached pointed leaves near bottom create compositional rhythm. Bright HOT PINK backdrop with a single large yellow corner shape. Mature original flat botanical graphic, no realistic veining or texture. Title BOTTOM LEFT in darkplum very bold irregular rounded sans, «ERES UN» smaller and «CHINGÓN» HUGE ivory on pink. Message TOP RIGHT darkteal heavy slab serif FOUR lines85px. No flowers, stars, faces, crowns, gradients.

seleccion.descripcion: Un formón coral produce una única viruta azul continua al deslizarse por un plano de madera amarillo.
seleccion.composicion: NO PEOPLE OR HANDS. A flat CORAL CHISEL with ivory blade slices one continuous elegant COBALT WOOD SHAVING from a long golden yellow wooden board crossing diagonally. Shaving rises into a large graceful spiral that frames the title without touching it. Board uses 3 simple long navy grain lines ONLY, no texture/3D. Rich deep EMERALD background, yellow/coral/ivory/cobalt. Title upper-right in IVORY heavy condensed sans «SOLO» small, «UNA» enormous inside open curl and «COSA» below. Exact message lower-left cream bold slab serif 4 lines85px. Original refined tool interaction, clean planes, no saw, workshop, plant or filler.

seleccion.descripcion: Un volante de bádminton coral y azul rebota junto a una red geométrica, sobre fondo amarillo y violeta.
seleccion.composicion: NO PEOPLE. A very graphic BADMINTON SHUTTLECOCK with coral rounded cork and five broad navy/ivory feather shapes rebounds up from a simple purple court baseline. A partial mint net with only 5 gridlines crosses the lower-right corner. Two sweeping coral bounce marks show resilience. Bold vivid YELLOW background, darkviolet/navy/coral/mint. Long exact TITLE has «13» HUGE dark violet at upperleft, with remaining title in thick darkviolet condensed sans stacked top-right and center-top, ensure all words fit at good scale. MESSAGE along bottom on clear deepviolet band in ivory heavy rounded sans FOUR lines85px. Artwork centered diagonal left; flat silhouette no feathery realism.

seleccion.descripcion: Dos castañuelas coral y azul se enlazan por un cordón y dibujan un ritmo compartido sobre fondo verde.
seleccion.composicion: NO HUMANS, NO HANDS. Two sets of CASTANETS, one large coral-red and one smaller cobalt, face one another in a diagonal visual conversation. Each has a pair of flattened rounded pear-shaped shells, ivory inner plane, tied by one continuous loose navy cord forming elegant loops. Three mint and plum rectangular rhythm marks between them show call-and-response. Bright fresh GREEN background, coral/cobalt/ivory. Flat playful editorial illustration with no wooden texture, no shiny highlights. Title BOTTOM RIGHT in IVORY heavy sharp slab serif stacked «Disciplina / sin lágrimas», lágrimas largest. Message TOP LEFT in deepnavy bold wide sans FOUR lines85px. No musicnote icons, tears or smiley faces.

seleccion.descripcion: Un caleidoscopio azul despliega un mosaico de formas coral, verde y marfil, sobre fondo violeta.
seleccion.composicion: NO PEOPLE. A sophisticated flat KALEIDOSCOPE tube, striped cobalt/coral/cream, lies diagonally from lower-left toward center; its circular opening unfolds into a radiant geometric MOSAIC of eight interlocking coral, mint, ivory and cobalt kite-shaped pieces, like a pattern spreading into the page. Every piece solid fill with sharp edges, not a stainedglass photo, no glass highlights. Vivid deep VIOLET backdrop. Title TOP LEFT in warm IVORY heavy rounded serif, varied hierarchy «Lo que he aprendido / en la vida», VIDA largest, art across middle and lower-left. Exact message BOTTOM RIGHT in mint bold condensed sans FOUR lines85px. Joyful rich graphic balance, not clutter, no stars, flowers or extra icons.
